_note: Pre-rule set kept only to reproduce final_hyborem_v1/ (the sprint's first second-unit check). Its poses strike to the lower-left although the sprite looks lower-right, which breaks the strike-direction rule in ANIMATING_UNITS.md. Do not copy it; use units/hyborem.json.
name: hyborem
description: Hyborem, a towering hulking demon lord: deep crimson skin, two huge curved black horns, burning yellow eyes and a fanged grin, black obsidian spiked armour with gold trim, a tattered dark red cape, a black flaming greatsword in his RIGHT hand, and a ring of solid orange-yellow flames around his feet
hands: the flaming greatsword stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand is an empty fist on the screen-right side

strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the greatsword cocked behind the head with the flaming blade hanging down behind the shoulders, left fist tucked in
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the flaming blade slashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, left arm swung back for balance

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (left fist flung out to the right, sword arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the greatsword dipping, left arm still out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, sword arm flung up, left arm drooping
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the greatsword's tip resting on the ground, left arm hanging, the flames around his feet shrinking
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, horns on the ground; the greatsword lies on the ground at the lower-left; the cape spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the cape settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes dark, the greatsword on the ground beside him, only a few small embers left
